mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.company_name as companyName FROM project p LEFT JOIN company c ON p.biz_no = c.biz_no
SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name" FROM users WHERE biz_no = #{bizNo} AND name LIKE '%' || #{term} || '%'

SELECT p.id, p.prj_name, p.PRJ_IDENTIFIER, p.prj_desc, p.created_on, p.closed_date, p.prj_hide, g.id AS group_id, g.name AS group_name, m.id AS member_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, p.biz_no FROM project p, grp g, member m, users u WHERE p.id = g.prj_id AND g.id = m.grp_id AND u.id = m.user_id AND p.biz_no = u.biz_no AND u.id = #{userId}
select ena_name_cd, get_sub_code_name(e.ena_name_cd) ena_name_nm from enabled_modules e where prj_id = #{prjId}
